content:
rachel (acct): Quick heads up 1: Comet Financial returned the RFI. They want a 10-day POC, private deploy into their AWS account, FIPS HSM integration, and a 12-month committed pricing band. Also requested a 1-page capability matrix and a plain-language key custody statement. Can we triage now?

peter (solutions): TL;DR blockers: NDA first, need HSM vendor+model+firmware, target latency SLO (they asked p95 <50ms for 32-token replies), and expected peak RPS.

katie (eng): 50ms p95 is doable with redwood-13B + int8 on dedicated A10s in-region, assuming modest QPS and small contexts. Need sample prompt distribution. On-prem HSM: we support KMIP and AWS CloudHSM; on-prem HSM will need a network-accessible KMIP endpoint.

omar (sec): Key custody: for Private we require customer-managed keys. Draft line: "Customer retains sole control of key material; Redwood stores encrypted references and never exports plaintext keys." Will add to appendix.

rachel (acct): Pricing ask: POC rate + committed monthly. Can we offer POC at 45% off list for up to 14 days and tiers: 4/16/48 GPUs? Keep conservative.

peter (solutions): Proposed commercial snippet: "POC: 45% off committed list for up to 14 days. Committed tiers: small(4 GPUs), mid(16), large(48). Per-GPU monthly list price + committed discount table attached." I'll draft CSV.

katie (eng): I'll produce a capability table with rows for redwood-7B/13B/70B and columns: quant, p95 latency (32/64 tokens), throughput per GPU, $/token estimate committed vs burst. Example: "redwood-13B | int8 | 38ms p95 (32t) | 110 req/s per A10 | $0.00095/token (committed)"

omar (sec): Also ask them for their compliance prompt set (PII samples) so we can run redaction and hallucination tests during POC.

ci-bot: Ticket #POC-6233 created and assigned to rachel, peter, katie. Due 2024-11-13.

rachel (acct): I'll request NDA + HSM contact + sample prompts + VPC CIDR + allowed ports in the handoff email. Please drop RFI appendix + 1-page capability + pricing CSV by EOD PST.

peter (solutions): Uploading initial RFI draft and capability one-pager shortly. Will include latency caveats re: prompt distribution and cache hit rates. :thumbsup:

katie (eng): Note for appendix: quantization impacts rare-token fidelity. Recommend running their critical prompts in fp16 and int8 during the POC. I'll attach a tiny eval script snippet.

rachel (acct): Great, thanks. Once NDA is signed I'll schedule the kickoff.
